# E0730: a struct in a schema has pattern constraints the Cap'n Proto compiler does not carry

The compiler carries a map as a lone [string]: T on a struct declaring no
other field. Pattern constraints of any other form (a regular expression, a
pattern beside declared fields, several patterns) are ones it does not carry
yet; the schema is valid.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				ports: {
					home: string
					[string]: string
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0730]: ports in schema 0.0 has pattern constraints the Cap'n Proto compiler does not carry
 --> lineage.cue:6:5
  |
6 |                 ports: {
  |                 ^^^^^
  |
  = note: ports in schema 0.0 has pattern constraints [string] beside its fields; the compiler carries only a lone [string]: T on a struct declaring no other field (Cap'n Proto rule unknown-pattern-labels)
  = help: declare the fields, or move the map to a field of its own
```
